author: Google DeepMind
description:
The mouse pointer 🖱️ has been a constant companion on computer screens, across every website, document and workflow. Despite how technologies have changed, the pointer has barely evolved in more than half a century. 

We’ve been exploring new AI-powered capabilities and ways of working to help the pointer not only understand what it’s pointing at, but also why it matters.

See how to try it out @ https://deepmind.google/blog/ai-pointer

title: Reimagining a 50-year-old interface (the mouse pointer) with AI
